Ngày xửa ngày xưa, làng Hollin giữ một c: Once upon a time, the village of Hollin kept a Great Storybook. Every monster was written into its pages, and each had to live exactly as its tale was told.
Một đêm sương, có thứ gì trườn lên từ sô: One misty night, something crawled out of the river and tore the pages loose. Freed from their old tales, the monsters woke: Grimbark in Thornwood, Sir Inkmaw in the Drowned Grotto, Vulpina in Emberhold.
Không còn trang nào giữ chân, chúng tự v: With no page to hold them, they began to write their own fates: whoever fights them, they learn from. No one knows how many pages were torn.
Jory, Liesel và Otto, ba bạn thân của Ro: Jory, Liesel and Big Otto, Rowan's three best friends, went looking for the torn pages, and the monsters took them.
Rowan, cầm lấy thanh kiếm này. Nó có hồn: Rowan, take this blade. It has a soul, and it remembers every swing you make. Go and save your friends. Hob is waiting at the ferry!
Rowan! Lão Cây Gai trói tớ trong rễ cả t: Rowan! Grimbark kept me tangled in roots for a whole week. Lucky you came!
Cháu mang về một trang rồi! Trong sách,: You brought a page home! The golden apple tree is back in the book. But Liesel is still trapped in the Drowned Grotto.
Jory đã về làng, ngồi chơi ở sân làng. B: Jory is home, playing on the village green. Jory taught Rowan to strike weak spots and shoot ink bolts farther: see Old Ambrose.
Nước dưới hang lạnh buốt... Cảm ơn Rowan: The grotto water was freezing... Thank you for diving down to find me, Rowan!
Thêm một trang về làng, giếng ước lại đầ: Another page is home, and the wishing well is full again! Across the river, Emberhold glows red with fire: Otto is in there.
Liesel is home, playing on the village green. Liesel taught Rowan longer-lasting effects and healing ink bolts: see Old Ambrose.
Mụ cáo bắt tớ canh lò sưởi cả tháng! Về: The fox witch made me tend her hearth for a month! Let's go home, I'm starving!
Trang thứ ba đã về, cối xay gió của làng: The third page is home, and the village windmill turns again. But the ink in the Great Storybook is still faint.
Otto đã về làng. Bạn ấy dạy Rowan gồng c: Otto is home. Otto taught Rowan to shrug off hits and shoot bigger ink bolts: see Old Ambrose.
Tối ấy cả làng mở hội dưới cây sồi già,: That night all of Hollin feasted under the old oak to welcome the three friends home. Three pages are back, but the Great Storybook is not whole yet. The end... or is it?
Đêm xuống, mặt sông lại gợn sóng, như có: At night the river ripples again, as if something down deep is still awake. Want a real test? Come to me and tap "Difficulty 2"!
Ba quái vật đã ngủ yên, nhưng nước sông: The three monsters sleep again, but the river is still murky. Lettie, Hob's daughter, went down to the dock to wash clothes and never came back.
Rowan ơi, cái bóng dài dưới sông bắt Let: Rowan, the long shadow in the river took Lettie! I'll row you upstream to Mirefen. Hold on tight!
Lindworm nhả ra một trang, ngoạm lấy Tra: The Lindworm spat out a page, snatched the Cover with the book's name on it, and dived away toward the far mountains.
Rowan ơi! Con rắn to ơi là to giấu tớ tr: Rowan! The giant serpent hid me in a cave behind the falls. Every night it drank the ink from its pages!
Lettie ơi, con về rồi! Cảm ơn Rowan. Tra: Lettie, you're home! Thank you, Rowan. Here is the fourth page: a flock of wild geese in flight.
Nó mang đi Trang Bìa. Trên Núi Bão, sấm: It took the Cover. Up on Stormpeak, thunder has roared since last night... Something is surely wrong.
Lettie is home, sitting at the dock with her dad.
Đêm xuống, mặt sông lại gợn sóng, như có: At night the river ripples again, as if something down deep is still awake. Rowan, open my map and head upstream to Mirefen!
Ta là Lão Cây Gai! Truyện cũ bắt ta đứng: I am Grimbark! My old tale kept me rooted forever. Now I write my own!
Tám xúc tu, một rìu san hô! Nhóc con dám: Eight arms and a coral axe! You dare wade into Sir Inkmaw's grotto, little one?
Chín đuôi lửa, một mặt nạ! Phù Thuỷ Cáo: Nine tails of fire and a mask! Vulpina has never lost!
Sách im rồi, cả dòng sông là của ta! Mực: The Book is silent, the whole river is mine! Page ink tastes so sweet, little one!
Hừ... Trang này ta mang đi. Lên núi rồi: Hmph... This page comes with me. You'll see, up on the mountain!
Rừng Gai yên rồi. Đò sang Hang Chìm được: Thornwood is quiet now. The ferry can cross to the Drowned Grotto, child.
Biển êm thật rồi! Bác chèo một mạch sang: The sea is calm at last! I'll row you straight to Emberhold.
Ba vùng yên ả. Muốn thử Độ khó 2 thì bảo: All three lands are at peace. Tell me if you want to try Difficulty 2.
Gỗ linh Rừng Gai đây rồi! Mang về bác rè: Spirit Wood from Thornwood! Bring it here and I'll forge for you.
Vảy cá Hang Chìm cứng thật, tôi lưỡi vào: Grotto fish scales are tough. Temper a blade with them and it gets razor sharp.
Lửa Lâu đài Than Hồng thổi lò mới hừng l: Emberhold fire makes my forge roar!
Jory về rồi, để cô may cho bạn ấy cái áo: Jory is back, let me sew a new shirt for that one.
Liesel lạnh run, cô đang đan cho cái khă: Liesel is shivering, I'm knitting her a scarf.
Otto đòi áo đỏ như lửa. Cô may ngay!: Otto wants a shirt as red as fire. Coming right up!
Lão Cây Gai bị viết vào truyện từ thuở x: Grimbark was written into the Book long ago. You beat him, and Thornwood breathes again.
Hiệp Sĩ Mực múa rìu san hô giỏi lắm. Chá: Sir Inkmaw swings a mean coral axe. You beat him, well done!
Phù Thuỷ Cáo cũng gục rồi. Chuyện Rowan: Even Vulpina has fallen. I'll write down how Rowan saved those friends in my finest hand.
Jory runs all over the village green. Noisy, but fun. The first page is back on the shelf.
Liesel về, sân làng có tiếng hát rồi. Ha: With Liesel back, there is singing on the green. Two pages are home.
All three friends are home. The Great Storybook feels warm again.
Nghe đây! Làng ơi, Rowan hạ được Lão Cây: Hear ye! Hollin, Rowan has beaten Grimbark!
Nghe đây! Biển êm, đò chạy, cả làng nghe: Hear ye! The sea is calm and the ferry runs again!
Nghe đây, nghe đây! Ba quái vật ngủ cả r: Hear ye, hear ye! All three monsters sleep! Let the feast begin!
Lettie về rồi, đò bác nhẹ hẳn! Muốn lên: Lettie's home, my boat feels light again! For Stormpeak, I'll only row you to its foot. The thunder is loud!
Vảy Lindworm cứng hơn cả sắt. Bác tôi lư: Lindworm scales are harder than iron. I temper blades in river water, razor sharp!
Lettie ướt hết áo, cô may cho bé cái váy: Lettie got soaked, so I'm sewing her a new green dress.
Lindworm chưa chết đâu, nó chỉ trốn. Thầ: The Lindworm isn't dead, it only fled. I'll write it down: "fourth page, the wild geese".
Bốn trang đã về giá sách. Còn bao nhiêu: Four pages are back on the shelf. How many more are out there, even I don't know...
Nghe đây! Lettie về làng rồi, cả làng ơi: Hear ye! Lettie is home, everyone!
Your blade remembers. Your enemies learn.
